note: Connecting sentences for explanations of scanned reports (task 12). Facts about each condition come from the condition entries, never from here. No numbers, no directive words.
summary_carrier: You are healthy. Your report shows you carry a change linked to {conditions}.
summary_carrier_body: Most people carry a few gene changes without knowing. Being a carrier mainly matters when planning children.
summary_carrier_body_simple: Most people carry some gene changes. It mainly matters for having children.
summary_none: Your report shows no changes in the conditions screened.
summary_none_body: This lowers the chance a lot, but no test can rule out every change.
summary_flagged: Some findings on your report need a specialist to explain them. They are not explained here.
summary_flagged_only: Your report has a result a genetic counsellor will go through with you, in your language.
summary_skipped: You skipped some findings. A counsellor can go through them with you.
summary_other_report: This looks like a different kind of report. A counsellor can explain it properly.
summary_unreadable: We couldn't read your report clearly enough to explain it. A counsellor can go through it with you.
carrier_heading: You carry one changed copy of the {gene} gene, which is linked to {condition}.
carrier_heading_no_gene: Your report shows a change linked to {condition}.
carrier_healthy: A carrier result is not a diagnosis. Carriers are healthy.
same_gene: It matters for children only if a partner carries a change in the same gene. A counsellor can explain the chances for each pregnancy.
same_gene_simple: It matters for children only if a partner carries a change in the same gene.
specialist: This finding needs a specialist to explain it. A genetic counsellor will go through it with you, in your language.
unmatched: We don't have a guide for this one yet. A counsellor can explain it.
